title: Vision-Language Models Performing Zero-Shot Tasks Exhibit Gender-based Disparities

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the difference in Average Precision (AP) and Expected Calibration Error (ECE) for visual concepts across perceived-gender groups in zero-shot vision-language models (CLIP, Detic, and LSeg) using the Visual Genome and MS-COCO datasets. The study also compares these visual performance disparities with cosine similarity differences found in word embeddings (word2vec).
